name: Storm Front (weather)
description: W8-J (plan SE-COMPLETE-1012, user-reported); P5 role note (plans/SETTLE-PACE-1015.md): the storm-front EVENT PARAMS object (fog density/color escalation, rise/hold/fall ramp timings, AREA span, exterior fog) — NOT a duplicate of the storm_front volumetric-cloud REGION, which is the ramp's WRITE TARGET (weather.js T8 writes the region's density/litColor live). systems/weather.js consumes this entity's params at runtime (resolveFront, frontEvent); the per-round seed roll and WALL clock stay deterministic. Defaults mirror dressing.fog.stormEvent + area — the data file is the source of record.

stormFront.exteriorSourceNote: W8-K (user-directed): the persistent EXTERIOR fog layer's editor-visible params — mirrors dressing.fog.exterior (alwaysOn/density/span; entity edit wins via frontEvent). FOG-ALWAYS-ON-FIX (plans/FOG-ALWAYS-ON-FIX.md, user-reported 2026-10-14): alwaysOn defaults FALSE — the exterior haze is opt-in; clear skies mount zero exterior boxes.
stormFront._note: Defaults == dressing.fog.stormEvent (+ .area.spanXZ); billboardColor matches the volumetric slab's stormColor #23272e so front + clouds read as ONE storm. _placeholder: the manual pins no storm numbers. Calm fog is NOT here by design — it rides the mounted per-style sky fog (dressing.fog + skybox seam); this object is the STORM escalation only.
